statement: Proposed conditional reduction: private uniform coefficient tags, checked rows retained without tag-dependent selection, a common factor-base column universe and a tag-blind nonzero kernel vector give a one-over-ell denominator failure without a statistical row-rank hypothesis. Under the separately unproved average-energy and planted-hit hypotheses, bounded base restarts can replace mandatory energy testing. The optional calibrated birthday diagnostic has quadratic RAM and is excluded from a linear-memory pipeline. These written arguments use established random-relation and sparse-linear-algebra methods; actual point/selection formalization, geometric bounds, full-base decomposition cost, a growing family, novelty and an improved exponent are not established.
